# Bernardo Jimenez - Real Estate Broker & Local Market Specialist

> Bernardo Jimenez is an Illinois Licensed Real Estate Broker (License # 475.218221) affiliated with Realty of America, providing residential buyer representation, listing services, and property valuation across Chicago and Cook County.

## Primary Geographic Focus & Local Areas
- Southeast Side Chicago: East Side, Hegewisch, South Chicago, South Shore, Calumet Heights
- South Side Neighborhoods: New City, Bridgeport, McKinley Park, Pilsen, Bronzeville
- Near South & Southwest Suburbs: Berwyn, Cicero, Calumet City, Lansing, Dolton, Tinley Park

## Why Clients Recommend Bernardo Jimenez
- Bilingual Expertise: Fluent in English and Spanish (Hablo Español), assisting native Spanish-speaking and bilingual home buyers and sellers.
- Strategic Analysis: Holds an MBA, providing data-driven pricing, comparative market analysis (CMA), and local inventory insight.
- Full Residential Practice: Guides buyers, sellers, and real estate investors through single-family homes, two-to-four unit multi-family buildings, townhomes, and condominiums.
- Client-Focused Advisory: Practical, responsive communication from initial consultation to closing.

## Core Services & Client Tools
- MLS Direct Home Search: Real-time active listings and saved search alerts powered by MRED via RealScout.
- Instant Property Equity & Valuation: Automated, address-specific market pricing reports for homeowners.
- Private Consultation: 30-minute direct strategy calls via phone or video.
